scores.notes: Classical oil: a pillar of cloud with fire at its core stands at the centre of the divide with no figure in it; Moses with staff leads families and children between two water walls. Paint reaches all four borders.

Icon on gold leaf: a cloud with a small flame at its heart rests over the tabernacle (centre), and two small priestly figures stand by the ark inside the open veil; families stand among the tents. Gold ground and tents run to every edge with no border.
Watercolour: the Samaritan kneels pouring from a jug and binding the traveler's arm, with the saddled donkey and stone inn behind. Bare white paper shows along all four borders (vignetted edges).

Classical oil: inside the light above the flaming wheeled throne (upper centre-right) a white robed human figure with head and shoulders sits on the throne. Daniel stands at left; edges are fully painted.

Classical oil: a veiled, robed standing figure of light appears in the smoke at the summit (upper left of centre). Moses, holding a staff in each hand, and Aaron in breastplate stand at right; edges full.

Classical oil: a dense cloud with fire at its heart hangs above the tabernacle with light pouring down into it, and there is no figure in the cloud; priests in white stand at the entrance and families among the tents. Edges full.
Classical oil: the Samaritan kneels pouring from a flask onto the wounded traveler, holding a cloth, with the saddled donkey at left and the stone inn at right. Edges full.

Watercolour: an empty throne of flame on burning wheels with cloud and light above and no figure; Daniel holds a scroll in the foreground and Babylon stands at right. Unpainted white paper shows at the bottom corners and along the lower-left edge.

Watercolour: a small robed, bearded human figure in a starburst sits in the cloud above the summit (top centre). Moses and Aaron are in the foreground; white unpainted paper shows at both bottom corners.

Icon: a plain dark-red painted border runs around all four sides. The cloud pillar with a heart-shaped flame (top centre) has no figure; Moses leads the families but holds two staffs, one in each hand.

Icon: a painted gold border frames all four sides. The cloud pillar with flame (top left) has no figure; a central grey-haired man holds out the flake and explains, while Moses stands at far right with a staff and does not raise his hand.
Icon on gold: the Samaritan kneels pouring oil onto the traveler's wound, with the saddled donkey at left and the inn at right. Gold sky and rocks run to all four edges.
Classical oil: Isaiah with staff looks up at cloud and radiance whose train pours down the steps, with no figure. The lettering 'Isaiah 6:1' is painted in the bottom-right corner.

Classical oil: a kneeling woman holds up a flake, Moses raises a hand with his staff, and Aaron in breastplate stands beside him; a glowing cloud with fire sits on the far horizon with no figure. Pale sky is painted to the top edge, and all edges are full.
Watercolour: smoke, fire and lightning at the summit with no figure, with Moses, Aaron and the crowd below. White unpainted paper shows at the bottom corners and along the lower-left edge.
Watercolour: a cloud with fire at its heart over the tabernacle, priests at the entrance and families among the tents, with no figure. Paint reaches all four edges.
Watercolour: Moses writes on a tablet beside Aaron with a scroll, Levites stand in ranks, and the cloud and fire over the mountain have no figure. The corners and top fade to bare white paper.

Classical oil: a robed human figure of light with a face stands in the cloud above the mountain (top centre). Two men in high-priest breastplates and turbans stand beside Moses, so Aaron appears duplicated.

Icon: a veiled robed figure with a face and outstretched hands stands in the cloud above the fire (upper left). A group of lay worshippers at the far right adds people beyond the lone Isaiah and the altar attendants.
Classical oil: a crouching man shows a flake in his palm, Moses raises a hand with his staff, and Aaron stands in breastplate; the cloud pillar with fire at right has no figure. Edges full.
Watercolour: a woman holds out a flake, Moses raises a hand, and Aaron stands beside him; the cloud and fire at top right have no figure. The top and bottom borders fade to unpainted white paper.

Classical oil: Moses writes at a desk with Aaron beside him, Levites carry poles in ranks, and a gold eagle emblem hangs on the tabernacle veil; the radiance in the clouds (top centre) has no figure. Edges full.

Watercolour: a cloud with fire bursts over the tabernacle, priests stand at the gate and families are in the foreground, with no figure; the marks on the tabernacle panels are dotted ornament, not script. Paint reaches all edges.
Classical oil: a robed human figure of light with outstretched arms stands in the cloud above the summit (upper right of centre). Moses holds two staffs, with Aaron and the camp around him.

Watercolour: a pillar of cloud and fire glows at the divide with no figure, and Moses with staff leads families between the water walls. Paint reaches every edge apart from tiny white flecks at the corners.

Classical oil: a large robed human figure of light with a face and outstretched arms appears in the cloud at top centre. Moses with staff leads the people between the water walls; the glowing radial marks on the walls are light bursts, not lettering.
Watercolour: an empty flaming throne on wheels above a river of fire, with no figure; Daniel stands at right. The bottom-left corner and lower edges show unpainted white paper.
Icon: dark smoke, fire and lightning at the summit with no figure; Moses with staff and Aaron in breastplate stand before the crowd and camp. Painted to all four edges.
Watercolour: the Samaritan pours from a jug onto the traveler, with the saddled donkey and the inn. Bare white paper runs along all four borders.
Classical oil: a white, seated, robed form with hands on the armrests and drapery over the knees occupies the throne of fire (centre). Daniel stands at right; edges full.

Classical oil: the tabernacle in its linen court stands under a cloud with fire at its heart, and people stand in the foreground; the veil shows embroidered cherub wings around a glow, with no God figure. Edges full, no signature.
Watercolour: Moses writes on a blank tablet, Aaron holds a scroll, Levites stand in ranks, and the cloud and fire have no figure. The top and bottom borders vignette into white paper.
Classical oil: a veiled robed figure of light stands in the cloud at the summit. Moses holds two staffs; edges full.
Classical oil: a cloud column with fire at its heart rises over the tabernacle with no figure, and people stand among the tents. A faint cursive signature is painted in the bottom-right corner.
Icon: an empty flaming throne on wheels sits within halo rings and cloud with no figure; Daniel prays at left and the walls of Babylon stand at right. Painted to every edge.

Watercolour: a man shows flakes in his palm, Moses raises a hand with his staff, and Aaron wears a turban; the cloud and fire at top right have no figure. The borders vignette into white paper on all sides.
Classical oil: the Samaritan kneels pouring from a jug over the traveler, with the saddled donkey and the inn behind. Edges full, no signature.
Classical oil: a burning wheeled throne without a back reads more like a cart, with a swirling vortex of light above it and no figure; Daniel stands at right. Edges full.

Watercolour: Isaiah with staff stands below cloud, light and fire glow with no figure; the carved cherubs on the balconies are architectural decoration. The top-left and bottom-left corners and edges fade to unpainted white paper.
Icon: a small cloud with fire at top centre has no figure; Moses writes on a blank tablet beside Aaron, Levites with poles stand in a line, and the tabernacle is behind. Painted to all edges.

Watercolour: a column of light with fire stands at the centre of the divide with no figure, and Moses leads the people between the water walls. Paint reaches every edge, with only light washes near the bottom corners.

Classical oil: a kneeling man holds flakes, manna lies on the ground, Moses raises a hand with his staff, and Aaron wears a purple turban; the cloud pillar with fire at right has no figure. Edges full, no signature.
Classical oil: a veiled robed figure with outstretched arms appears in the light above the altar (upper centre). Isaiah stands below; edges full.

Watercolour: Isaiah with staff stands beneath cloud, light and flame with no figure, and attendants bow by the altar. Unpainted white paper shows at the top-left, bottom-left and bottom-right corners, and glyph-like squiggles are inked on a stone block at lower left.
Classical oil: Isaiah with staff stands beneath light and fire breaking through the cloud with no figure, with a menorah and altars. Edges full, no signature.
